Dialogs.Dialog: ▲主人公＊▲. Running into you in a place like this, what a surprise.
I'm surprised too... Are you watching the fountain？
It caught my eye. I always end up spacing out watching flowing water.
Huh... flowing water, huh. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ has an interesting way of seeing things.
Something like that. You too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. This is the perfect spot for a walk.
Yeah, the view is great and it feels nice.
If I get to see you, maybe I'll always come this way on my walks？
Sounds good. Maybe I'll do the same？
Huh. What are you doing there, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
▲主人公＊▲. Um... I'm not doing anything.
When I feel a little tired, I come here. Taking a breather is important too, right？
A breather, huh... then maybe I'll take one too.
Yo, what a coincidence. Were you watching a movie？
No, I came to get a flyer for a movie that's coming out.
You must be looking forward to it. Then, want to come see it together？
Sorry, I promised to see it with my friends...
Haha, rejected. Well, if you've got plans, it can't be helped.
Rejected？ ...I can go on a date with you anytime.
▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Fancy running into you here.
Nothing. I have somewhere to be, so see you.
Yo, what a coincidence. What are you up to？
I was nearby, so I wondered what movies are showing. I don't have time to watch one now, though.
There's a schedule at the entrance. Do you have time to go look at that？
I was doing some practice on my own. I'm just heading home.
Right, and I would've trained you hard, too...
Just kidding. Well, do your best.
(Maybe it's good the timing didn't work out？)
Yo. "Oh no" is kind of harsh.
Sorry. I didn't think I'd see you.
You didn't want to see me that much？
Of course not... I wanted to keep it a secret that I come here.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Were you at the sports center？
My body felt a little heavy this morning. So I came to check.
Yes, it was just my imagination. Manaka is in top form today too.
Lucky to run into you. Want to go together？
I'm done shopping, and I have to go home now...
Oh, it was you... hehe, I'm so surprised I'm laughing.
Haha. Yeah, moments like this do make you laugh.
It really is. Since it's a coincidence, can I ask you something？ Curry or stew, which would you want tonight？
Thank you, I couldn't decide. I'll make curry tonight. Well, Mama's waiting, so bye.
(Dinner for the Takane family, huh... I thought she was making it for me.)
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Looks lively, huh？ Came to check it out？
Just on my walk. I need to get back soon.
Let's come together next time. See you.
▲主人公＊▲. Running into you here, isn't that something？
Yeah. I was looking for something fun going on.
Haha, if I were, I'd have invited ▲高嶺＊＊▲ from the start.
Of course you would... Just kidding.
I just got here. Ahh, if only I'd come a bit earlier...
We can see each other anytime... but it is a little disappointing.
Hey, what game are you going to play？
You're going to the arcade, right？ Don't stay too late, okay？
I know, I know. Want to come too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I have to go home now. See you.
Were you peeking into the arcade？ Maybe you were planning to go in alone？
No way... ah, right, I have an errand.
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. So you were over here.
Sorry, I'm running an errand right now.
Then I guess not. Well, let's go together sometime.
That's right, with Papa and Mama. They're over there, see？
Hey, what's the difference between the stuff on this shelf and that one？
Um... ah, there's a catalog. Hold on...
Thank you. I'm not very good with this kind of thing...
Excuse me, could I get some help？
Just kidding. Did I fool you？
I knew it was ▲高嶺＊＊▲. I can tell by your voice.
Oh... hmm, I'll have to change my voice too.
(No need to work that hard at it...)
Ah, a boyfriend sighting... Just kidding.
Um... I'm not sure. Still deciding.
Can you sample it？ Then I'd like to listen too.
All right, if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ likes it, maybe I'll buy it.
(Come to think of it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ likes Chopin...)
Chopin starts with a C, you know？
What's this, do you like piano music？
Well... something like that. I think ▲高嶺＊＊▲ said she liked it.
Hehe. That makes me kind of happy▼
(I know the melody, but I can't think of the title.)
That bag, did you buy something？
(I wonder what she bought here... Now I'm curious.)
What a coincidence. Did you come shopping？
Not to buy anything in particular, though.
Yeah, this place is fun just for that.
I see... I'd like to go with you, but I have to go now.
I see, too bad. Let's come again sometime.
▲高嶺＊＊▲, did you have business here？
Yes. But there's so much, I got overwhelmed.
Huh, what kind of stuff are you into, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
It's not for me. My aunt is looking for a present for a friend's child, so I'm doing research.
You even do that kind of thing？ Want some help？
Really？ Thank you, that'd be a big help.
You don't have to be that surprised...
I was just passing by here by chance... Really, okay？
I haven't even asked anything yet...
By any chance, do you have business at this shop？
Hmm... is there some girl you've got your eye on here？
Huh！ No way！ I just want some tea！
...Didn't you say you had no business here？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Were you just peeking into this shop？
...Hey, do you think that uniform is cute？
The maid outfit？ Well, sure... it's cute, I guess？
If I worked part-time there, I could wear that.
It'd be cute, but I wouldn't want other guys seeing you...
...Geez, how can you say things like that so openly？
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Fancy running into you here.
I come here sometimes. Shrines have a special atmosphere, and I like it.
True. It makes you stand up straight.
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Running into you right now can't be a coincidence！
So, why don't we draw fortunes together？
Hmm... no. I want to save that for a day when we properly come to pray. Besides, I have something urgent to do.
▲主人公＊▲. Running into you here, that's unexpected.
What are you doing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Making a wish？
Something like that. But what I wished for is a secret.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Running into you in an unexpected place.
I'd love to keep you company, but I have something to do... Then again, maybe practicing alone is better. Good luck.
I'm about to go bowling. Want to come？
Sorry. There's somewhere I have to be now.
I see. If you have plans, it can't be helped.
Good luck bowling. Go for it！
All right, let's go for a personal best！
▲高嶺＊＊▲！ What a coincidence. Were you bowling？
With my friends. Look, the score sheet.
I did my best. As my boyfriend, you can't lose to that, right？ Well, my friends are waiting, so I'll go.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Were you at karaoke, by any chance？
Yes, with some friends from my class.
No way. There's girls-only secret talk, you know.
(Maybe I'll practice a new song in secret...)
Alone？ Ah, were you practicing or something？
Geez... you don't have to point that out.
Shall we come here on our next date？
Hehe, what a coincidence. I think I like your surprised face.
(It's a face I'd rather not have seen...)
Not really. Do you train in this park, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Sometimes. This is the perfect finish line for my jog.
Huh... finishing here, huh. Sounds nice.
Right？ It's like, "And Takane crosses the finish line！"
Oh, hi. Out for a walk？
Yes, walking the dog with a kid from the neighborhood.
Oh, that kind of walk. Huh, where's the dog？
I saw you, so I left them waiting over there. Bye.
▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing over there？
Could it be... tennis practice？ Ball games aren't allowed here.
No, no. Today I'm just... taking a walk.
(I can't exactly tell her I'm scouting for a date...)
Yeah, just grabbing some tea. You too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I just wanted a change of pace. I thought it might be nice to study somewhere other than my room for once.
I see. So, how did it go？
Maybe not so well. I'll go home and keep at it.
Sorry, sorry. Then how about now？
I have something to do after this.
...Then inviting you wouldn't have worked anyway.
Even so, I wanted you to ask.
▲主人公＊▲. Actually, I tried ordering takeout.
Geez, treating me like a kid.
Haha, sorry, sorry. By the way, are you free now？
No, I have to go home. Sorry.
Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you up to？
Shopping with my family. I saw you, so I came after you.
All this way？ Sorry about that.
No. It would be sad to see you and not even say hi. Bye.
Yo. I was just about to go into this shop.
Well, Papa's waiting over there... want to go in, the three of us？
When you live alone, you can eat whenever and wherever you want. I think that's amazing.
(It gets to be a pain every day, though...)
You like the food here？ Hmm...
I wonder if I could make it too. Hehe.
This place was featured on TV a while ago, right？
I thought you came because you saw that. Not the case？
Nope. I just felt like it.
Hehe, you just felt like it？
Can we pretend that never happened？
It was kind of cute, so say it one more time？ Then I'll forget it.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Eating here, by any chance？
▲主人公＊▲. I was just passing by.
I see. I thought, since we ran into each other, we could eat together.
Sorry, I have something to do.
It's fine, just seeing you makes me happy.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you doing here？
Scouting for a date... Just kidding. I'm just taking a walk. And you？
I'm scouting for a date too, I guess.
Ah... sorry, I didn't notice you.
Same here. I was kind of spacing out.
I might have been spacing out too.
Earlier I ran into a friend from the girls' team too. Today is a day of coincidences.
Stuff like that comes in streaks. You might run into someone else later？
I already met the person I wanted to see most, so I'm fine... Just kidding.
Ah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. What are you up to？
I'm just heading home... and you？
Me, just this and that. We meet and say bye right away, huh.
Right. But I got to see you, even just for a moment... Just kidding. Bye.
(Hmm, it wasn't quite enough for me.)
Sorry. I'm in a hurry... huh？
So cold, miss girlfriend of mine！
That's... because you called out to me like that！
Haha, sorry, sorry. But you did notice it was me.
I could tell by your voice... It's frustrating that I didn't notice right away, though...
Oops, sorry. Did I startle you？
Haha, what a coincidence. No, maybe it's fate!?
Now that I've found you, prepare yourself... Just kidding.
(That's what you say to your sworn enemy.)
My magazine horoscope said something good would happen in this direction. It came true.
Something good, meaning running into me？ Haha.
Huh？ What's wrong, why so surprised...
...Sorry. I was thinking about you, and then you suddenly appeared, so it surprised me.
I see. I was thinking about ▲高嶺＊＊▲ too.
Oh, you're such a smooth talker. Geez.
▲主人公＊▲. Are you out for a walk too？
Actually... I've been wandering the city searching for ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
I don't believe you. I'm not that naive.
▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Yo. You're in a really good mood.
That's because I'm on a date.
Oh... don't tease me like that.
